verses.original: לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֭רַח מִזְמ֣וֹר שִׁ֑יר יְ֝סוּדָת֗וֹ בְּהַרְרֵי־ קֹֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ miz·mō·wr šîr yə·sū·ḏā·ṯōw bə·har·rê- qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: A Psalm of the sons of Korah A song He has founded His city on the holy mountains

verses.original: אֹהֵ֣ב יְ֭הוָה שַׁעֲרֵ֣י צִיּ֑וֹן מִ֝כֹּ֗ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ Yah·weh ša·‘ă·rê ṣî·yō·wn mik·kōl miš·kə·nō·wṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob

verses.original: נִ֭כְבָּדוֹת מְדֻבָּ֣ר בָּ֑ךְ עִ֖יר הָאֱלֹהִ֣ים סֶֽלָה׃
verses.literal: Glorious things are ascribed to you O city of God Selah

verses.original: אַזְכִּ֤יר׀ רַ֥הַב וּבָבֶ֗ל לְֽיֹ֫דְעָ֥י הִנֵּ֤ה פְלֶ֣שֶׁת וְצ֣וֹר עִם־ כּ֑וּשׁ זֶ֝֗ה יֻלַּד־ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ’az·kîr ra·haḇ ū·ḇā·ḇel lə·yō·ḏə·‘āy hin·nêh p̄ə·le·šeṯ wə·ṣō·wr ‘im- kūš zeh yul·laḏ- šām
verses.literal: I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me along with Philistia Tyre and Cush when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion

verses.original: וּֽלֲצִיּ֨וֹן׀ יֵאָמַ֗ר אִ֣ישׁ וְ֭אִישׁ יֻלַּד־ בָּ֑הּ וְה֖וּא יְכוֹנְנֶ֣הָ עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lă·ṣî·yō·wn yê·’ā·mar ’îš wə·’îš yul·laḏ- bāh wə·hū yə·ḵō·wn·ne·hā ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: And it will be said of Zion This one and that one were born in her and the Most High Himself will establish her

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה יִ֭סְפֹּר בִּכְת֣וֹב עַמִּ֑ים זֶ֖ה יֻלַּד־ שָׁ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yis·pōr biḵ·ṯō·wḇ ‘am·mîm zeh yul·laḏ- šām se·lāh
verses.literal: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples This one was born in Zion Selah
Singers and pipers will proclaim All my springs of joy are in You
